data.name: Teodora
data.gender_notes: Teodora is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Theodora means 'God's gift' in Greek. The name is derived from the Greek words 'theos' meaning 'God' and 'doron' meaning 'gift'. In Christianity, Teodora is a name given to girls born to devout parents as a sign of thanksgiving and dedication to God. The name Teodora carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Teodora usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the spirit of gratefulness and devotion to God.
data.etymology: Teodora belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Teodora total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: תיאודורה
in_hebrew.meaning: מתנה מאלוהים, שנת אלוהים, הודיה לאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: תיאודורה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית, מורכב מ'תיאוס' (אלוהים) ו'דורון' (מתנה), כלומר 'מתנה מאלוהים' או 'שנת אלוהים'. השם הוא ביטוי להודיה לאל על הילד שנולד והוא נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנוצרית, תוך שילוב של אלמנטים יווניים ומשמעות מקראית.

in_greek.name: Θεοδώρα
in_greek.meaning: Θεοδώρα, δωρά από τον Θεό, δωρο του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Θεοδώρα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα, συνδυασμός των λέξεων 'Θεός' (Θεο) που σημαίνει Θεός και 'δωρά' (δώρα) που σημαίνει δώρα ή χαρίσματα. Το όνομα Θεοδώρα σημαίνει 'δώρο από τον Θεό' ή 'δώρο του Θεού', αντανακλώντας την πνευματική ευγνωμοσύνη προς τον Θεό για το παιδί που γεννιέται. Αυτό το όνομα έχει ιστορικά ριζωμένη στη χριστιανική παράδοση και φέρει βαθιά πνευματική σημασία.

in_latin.name: Theodora
in_latin.meaning: Donum Dei, Dei donatio, gratia divina
in_latin.long_meaning: Theodora est nomen christianum quod ex graeca lingua originem ducit, compositum ex 'theos' (Deus) et 'doron' (donum), quod significat 'donum Dei' seu 'Dei donatio'. Hoc nomen est expressio gratiarum actionis erga Deum pro nato filio et habet profundam significationem spiritualem in cultura christiana, coniungens elementa graeca et significationem biblicam.

in_english.name: Teodora
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, God's gift, Divine gift
in_english.long_meaning: Teodora is a Christian name derived from the Greek words 'theos' (God) and 'doron' (gift), meaning 'Gift of God' or 'God's gift'. This name expresses gratitude to God for the child born and carries a deep spiritual significance in Christian culture. It combines Greek elements with biblical meaning, reflecting a profound connection to divine providence. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian traditions, symbolizing the belief in God's benevolence and grace.

Girls named Teodora are encouraged to live their lives in accordance with these values and to always remember that they are God's gifts to the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Teodora signifies the gift of God's grace and the virtue of God-fearing in a woman. It is a name that embodies divine favor and the strength of character that comes from unwavering faith.

historical_references.reference: Saint Teodora of Rome, martyred in the 3rd century AD, is venerated as a patron saint of difficult pregnancies and childbirth.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
